SELECT COUNT(*) FROM learning_paths WHERE status = 'completed'

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'active' THEN 1 END) as activePaths, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN 1 END) as completedPaths, COALESCE(SUM(total_steps), 0) as totalSteps, COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'active' THEN progress_percentage END), 0.0) as averageProgress FROM learning_paths
